title: REQ · Scene view honors visibility conditions and persistent state
summary: getSceneView and validateWorld use visibleWhen and persistentState
description: Context: getSceneView only supports openWhenFlag. Desired behavior: objects with visibleWhen conditions that fail are omitted; open derives from persistentState.flag (stored in GameState.flags, which persistence already saves) with openWhenFlag fallback; validateWorld checks the flags referenced. Expected result: the bookshelf stays open after the flag is set. Why: persistent object states.
acceptance_criteria: Given visibleWhen flag false, when getSceneView runs, then the object is absent
Given persistentState flag true in state, when getSceneView runs, then open is true
Given persistentState references an undeclared flag, when validateWorld runs, then 'unknown flag' error is returned
